data.name: RogueBike GP
data.detailed_description:
RogueBike GP is a top-tier motorcycle racing game where any resemblance to real-world racing is purely accidental. 🏍️💨

  • Create and customize your racing team with Roguelike Progression 🏁

  • Recruit the right team and upgrade your HQ to boost your bike's performance 🏗️

  • Become world champion in campaign mode 🌍

  • Compete globally in asynchronous multiplayer 🏆

  • Play Co-Op with up to 8+ players in any mode 🎮👨‍👧

Burn Rubber Around the World in Asynchronous Races

Challenge riders from across the globe in high-speed time trial races. Submit your best laps and face off against new opponents on ever-changing circuits and conditions. Will your racing line and throttle control be enough to stay ahead of the pack and dominate the leaderboards?

Ride Together in 8-Player Co-op

Whether it’s split-screen, shared screen, or via Steam Remote Play, invite your friends to race alongside you. Drop-in co-op lets players join anytime, in campaign mode or while chasing online glory. Team up for the constructors’ crown or battle it out for bragging rights!

Weekly Challenges Straight from the Moto World

Take on fresh challenges every week inspired by real-world championship races. Adapt to new tracks, weather, and wild racing scenarios to prove your skill. Earn exclusive rewards and show you are the fastest.

Outsmart, Outlean, Outride

Strategic bike development, tyre choices, and changing weather; it's not just about raw speed. Master the race craft, take perfect racing lines, and plan the overtake. Every corner is a decision, and every decision could mean the podium.

Build the Ultimate Racing Team

Start from scratch and grow your team into a two-wheeled juggernaut. Manage your facilities, sign sponsors, and develop your bike to perfection. Improve everything from engine power to team morale, and rise through the ranks on your quest to become Moto 2D World Champion.

Customize Your Dream Bike

Design the perfect machine, from sleek liveries to bold color schemes. Express your style while chasing the checkered flag. Your bike, your rules, your victory.

Race, Rank, and Reap Rewards

Climb the online rankings in asynchronous time trials and multiplayer challenges. Win races, unlock new bikes, skins, gear, and much more. Only the fastest and most consistent riders will take home the rarest rewards.

Everything You Love About Motorcycle Racing

  • 20+ international circuits

  • Dynamic weather conditions

  • "Realistic" tyre and fuel strategy

  • Aggressive AI rivals

  • And way more two-wheeled mayhem!
